verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own docs show AI-driven interaction surfaces: an official MCP server through which agents like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT reach data via Airbyte Agents to 'query, search, and act' on it, plus an AI Assistant that prefills Connector Builder fields. None of this is documented as natural-language commands that operate the platform itself (creating connections, running syncs, managing schedules). Natural-language use runs through external MCP agents and is scoped to data rather than pipeline management, and the AI Assistant is only shown prefilling configuration, not taking free-form instructions. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core platform operations (connections, syncs, schedules), evidence that the AI Assistant accepts free-form commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.
Equip your agents to query, search, and act on your data in real-time
AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder, drastically reducing setup time.
